_comment: aowl.graphics — full-frame post-process (AgX tonemap + color grade + sharpen + bloom + vignette). The RENDERING runs client-side in the host (abi/aowlspt_graphics.h) over the DXGI back buffer; this file is only the control surface. Keys are flat so the F12 settings UI and the write-back path both address them directly. See README.md for what each does and the screen-space caveat (this grades the shipped LDR frame, it is not a literal replacement of BSG's HDR tonemapper).
//raidOnly: When true (default), the grade runs ONLY inside a raid; the main menu and 2D UI screens stay stock. The raid signal comes from the backend (the tarkov mod knows raid start/end). Set false to grade everywhere, including the menu — also the escape hatch if you run without the backend/manager, since without the signal the gate stays closed.
//tonemapper: 0 = none, 1 = AgX (filmic, neutral highlights — default), 2 = ACES. tonemapStrength blends the look 0..1.
//exposure: EV bias applied before the tonemap look. 0 = neutral.
//lgg: Lift/Gamma/Gain — shadows offset, midtone power, highlight scale.
//legacy: shadows (additive lift) and highlights (pre-tonemap roll-off) match the original TarkovGraphics knobs.
//bloom: bloom enables the bright-pass blur; bloomStrength is the composite amount 0..2.
//vignette: vignette strength 0..1; vignetteRadius 0.5..1.5 (larger = darkening starts further out).
//diag: Red-tint the frame to confirm the post-process blit lands on the right back buffer. Turn off for normal play.
